name: Fraction Pizza
description: Cut pizzas and pies and serve slices: halves and quarters, equal fractions, adding slices, fractions on a number line.

about.concept: Fractions as parts of a whole and as positions on a line. Cutting and serving slices makes equal parts, equivalent fractions and adding fractions concrete before they are written.
about.progression: Halves and quarters come first, then thirds, sixths and eighths, then matching equal fractions, adding slices with the same denominator, and placing fractions on a number line.
lifeSkills: Explaining why two amounts are the same
